messages:
Taylor (CEO): Quick weekly note 1: GA readiness & private beta progress. Short and actionable. Pls scan.
Priya (VP Product): Double congrats to teams shipping private API tests. Two asks: 1) docs checklist complete by Wed EOD; 2) customer beta feedback loop documented. Link: https://go/redwood/private-beta-guide
Diego (VP Eng): Infra update: rolled kernel patch for 8k sequence perf. Saw ~8% p95 improvement in staging. Still validating memory footprint on quantized shards. Canary planned midnight Fri.
Lin (CFO): Financial snapshot: ARR motion is trending +4% WoW. Early Dedicated deposits at $72k MRR in sales funnel. Recommend holding on expanded quota until GA conversion rate clearer.
Noah (Head of Customer): Beta highlight: early customers request SLA language for throughput tiers. I'll draft an FAQ and sample contract clause. Need legal review.
Priya (VP Product): Owners for this week: docs (Priya), SLA draft (Noah & Legal), canary + rollback (Diego), pricing cadence (Lin).
people-bot: Reminder: hiring pause in effect for non-critical roles until next fiscal review. Exceptions require manager + finance sign-off.
Taylor (CEO): Risk log: 1) delayed canary => delay GA window; 2) docs gaps => support burden. Mitigations: stretch canary window by 48h if needed; triage doc gaps with rotations.
Diego (VP Eng): Canary snippet we'll use in config: ```canary_percent=12
models=["dedicated-v2","dedicated-v2-quant"]
fallback="hosted-standard"
monitors=latency_p95,error_rate,cost_per_token```
Priya (VP Product): Customer comms plan: pre-GA note, release notes, migration guide, and one webinar. Noah will run webinar ops.
Lin (CFO): Cost ops: Redwood Optimize changes reduced GPU token cost by ~12% last month, but watch for quality regressions. Recommend a rolling flag that ties optimize profiles to evaluation harness.
Noah (Head of Customer): Webinar scheduled Tue 11am PT. Please add any demo requests to the doc.
Taylor (CEO): Two behavioral asks: ping me on critical go/no-go decisions, and mark owner updates with :white_check_mark: when done. Thanks for scrubbing this. Big week ahead.
Priya (VP Product): I'll post a short GA checklist update here tomorrow.
Diego (VP Eng): Canary scheduled Fri 00:00 UTC. Ops will limit traffic and enable auto-rollback on >1% error spike.
Lin (CFO): Pricing draft incoming Thu AM for review.
people-bot: Calendar: all-hands for managers Fri 9:30am PT (topic: hiring guardrails & runway update).
Taylor (CEO): Closing 1: react with :thumbsup: if you're aligned.
Priya (VP Product): :thumbsup:
Diego (VP Eng): :thumbsup: (watching canary)
Lin (CFO): :thumbsup: (pricing in flight)
Noah (Head of Customer): :thumbsup: (webinar ready)
